Neither random search touched the +0x270 crux nor generated the pre-banned dual-typed read; there is no third structurally-distinct clean chassis to reseed (the floor-4 u16-local-PHI chassis is itself a banned-family form, not a clean seed).
frontier.mechanism: The +0x270 clamp inherently needs a SIGNED compare (slti/lh) AND an unsigned/opaque index (unfolded lhu) of ONE field; a single typed read delivers exactly one, and every construct supplying both is a dual typed view = the pre-banned signedness-split family. Random mutation from either basin cannot cross this dichotomy.
